headline: On last trading day, Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points as banking and IT stocks led a sharp decline

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: The NSE and BSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, in observance of the Dussehra holiday.
In the last session, the Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points, wiping out Rs 5 lakh crore in wealth.
Banking and IT stocks led the market decline during Monday's significant sell-off.
The Nifty50 dropped 1.11%, closing below the 22,900 mark on the previous trading day.
whatHappening: Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.50 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Wednesday IPO opening.
PNB has issued a warning to its customers regarding a surge in AI-led cyberattacks and fraud.
Federal Bank is identified as a top stock recommendation for the upcoming trading session on Wednesday.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement has officially come into effect as of today, October 20.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for Dussehra following a volatile session on Monday where the Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points. Banking and IT stocks led the losses, wiping out Rs 5 lakh crore in investor wealth. Trading will resume on Wednesday, October 21.
